proposals.rationale: Hypothesis: removing the argon operational context could permit air or moisture exposure during catalyst activation and reaction setup.
Hypothesis: reducing the 80 °C reaction hold from 12 h to the existing 2 min duration could leave the transformation incompletely progressed.
Hypothesis: deletion of the heating-block device removes the source-reported means of maintaining the specified 80 °C reaction condition.
Hypothesis: deleting the reactor-to-heater connection could prevent the reactor from receiving the intended thermal treatment.
Hypothesis: substituting B2pin2 for the KOtBu addition removes the designated base function and changes the activation environment.
